what: float64 value-and-gradient of 0.5 mean over the N^D points of a uniform tensor grid on [-1, 1)^D of (L u - f)^2 for separable networks u(x) = sum_r prod_d phi_d(x_d)_r (one tanh MLP 1 -> 64 -> 64 -> 64 -> R per axis), linear L with constant or separable coefficients and a separable target (sum of 3 products of cosines); candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.separable_grid (Taylor-mode per-axis derivative tables, then the weighted squared norm of the rank-J CP residual as a Hadamard product of per-axis J x J Gram matrices; grid never materialised); second run (new seed, cells, widths 48 / 64 / 96 and depths 3 / 4 / 5): candidate = separable_grid_loss with tables from omnibias.jax.experimental.separable_grid.mlp_axis_tables (one batched product per layer over all Taylor orders and all axes, exact tanh series recurrence)
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method on the 3^D (2^D when 3^D > 64) sub-grid of the first nodes vs a 40-digit oracle (truncated Taylor series in x with a dual part along a fixed random parameter direction): loss 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivative 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.explicit_grid_residual: the same separable model and derivative tables with the residual materialised on the N^D grid: one rank-J CP GEMM chain; one rank-R outer product per operator term (the reference separable-network residual); the same per term with nested forward-mode tables (stacked-table run: also the CP GEMM chain from the stacked tables and from vmapped Taylor-mode tables)
tiers.previous_package: stacked-table run only: the candidate of the first run (separable_grid_loss with per-axis Taylor-mode tables)

roles.held_out: cells and seed not used for any tuning

full_grid_accuracy.what: max over repetitions of relative deviations of the loss and of gradient norms / sampled gradient entries (scaled by the largest sampled magnitude) between methods on the full grid

full_grid_accuracy_stacked_tables.what: max over repetitions of per-field relative deviations (norms and sampled entries scaled by the largest sampled reference magnitude) between methods at full size; floor = two controls

cold_cost.what: per cell, medians over repetitions: cold = lowering + compilation ms (excluded from the speed ratios), steady = steady-state median ms, for the candidate and the steady-state-fastest member of every tier; break_even_calls = extra cold ms / steady saving per call (only when the candidate compiles slower and runs faster)
